_comment: Local development overrides. Runs fully offline with mock integrations (decision A5).

analysis._comment: One analysis at a time, so requests do not exceed Groq's per-minute limit.

ownership._comment: Sample mapping for the mock data: GitHub logins / DAG owners -> Linear users.

approval._comment: Mock mode only. In production set ONCALL_TRUSTED_APPROVERS.
